blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — State-backed sovereign wealth fund manager Maharlika Investment Corp. (MIC) has agreed to invest up to P900 million in Tubig Pilipinas Holdings Inc. to fund the utility provider’s water network expansion across the Philippines.
